children.name: question
children.label: Question
children.default: Why are Audio Bibles so important?

children.name: richtext_field
children.label: Rich text
children.default: Approximately 70% of people worldwide learn primarily through audible communication, meaning that around 5.7 billion people need to hear the gospel to understand and accept it. Shockingly, over 1 billion people still do not have access to God's Word in a format they can understand. Our partnership with Faith Comes by Hearing (FCBH) brings God’s Word to those who have never heard the gospel in their native language.
